title: Captions from the word JSON (clean and pop)
what_it_does: Writes a HyperFrames caption sub-composition from the word JSON: 'clean' shows sentence lines on a soft scrim, 'pop' highlights the spoken word, 2-3 words at a time. Colours and fonts come from the brand's frame.md (frame-vars.mjs makes the CSS variables). Safe zones for 16:9 and 9:16.
when_to_use: Any video with speech that needs on-screen text; most viewers watch muted. Feed it the retimed word JSON from silence-cut (or a short's word file). Not for lyrics or non-spaced scripts (Chinese, Japanese).
notes: Own code, following HyperFrames' references/captions.md (group size, hard kill, safe zones). Expected check warnings: composition_file_too_large and timeline_track_too_dense on long videos; they are about file size, not about the picture. End-to-end proof: catalog/lanes/talking-head/example/run-proof.sh.
